description: Downscaled CMIP3 and CMIP5 Climate and Hydrology Projections is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Analytics Group; Climate Central; Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. This archive contains high-resolution translations of climate projections for the contiguous United States. Archive content is based on global climate projections from the World Climate Research Programme’s Coupled Model Intercomparison Projects. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
